args.all.description: Gives you every variable of the running action at once, like user, message and rewardTitle.
args.all.returns: An object with every variable name and its value.

args.get.description: Reads one variable of the running action, like the user who triggered it.

parameters.name: The variable name without % signs, like "user".

args.get.returns: The value, or null when the action has no variable with that name.

args.set.description: Sets a variable of the running action. Later sub-actions can use it as %name%.

parameters.name: The variable name without % signs, like "winner".
parameters.value: The value to store: text, a number, true/false or a list. Leave it out to set it to empty (null).
